findings: Adding api: service_healthy to key consumers is not a general guarantee: Gunicorn may have multiple workers, API can be scaled, and migration or direct starts can race. It also does not cover --no-deps or another Compose project.

Recommended Compose-level serialization: add a one-shot private API image init_secret_key service. After init_permissions succeeds, initialize the configured storage adapter and call resolve_secret_key once without printing the value. Gate api, api_websocket, worker, worker-gaia, worker-dataset, worker_beat, and migration on init_secret_key service_completed_successfully.

This provides a single key seed before the listed Compose consumers, avoids API/worker/agent dependency cycles, and preserves explicit SECRET_KEY behavior. Manual bypasses and cross-project starts remain operationally constrained; general storage compare-and-set would require reopening M02 and registering backend source/tests.
Change the init_permissions command to `chown ... && touch ... || exit 1` so either failure returns nonzero and cannot be masked by the success echo. This preserves existing marker behavior.
The migration release command uses --no-deps, so its documented preflight must explicitly complete init_permissions and init_secret_key before running the migration service.
